comparison: Multi reciprocal constraint/validation days; fixed 2000-cell endpoint pools; physical time
preprocessing: First 100 supplied PCA coordinates, standardized using the fixed endpoint pools.
sigma_rule: RMS within-endpoint standard deviation, pooled with equal endpoint weights; fixed before any empirical W2 evaluation
target_source: Full constraint-day mean of the frozen classifier posterior
information_budget: Endpoint samples and OT coupling; a frozen classifier trained on the constraint day; seven empirical classifier-posterior means. Full constraint-day cells are used to prepare the observation, while path training receives its aggregate. LAND references use endpoints only.
